name: v1.4.281
body: ## Even better agy support, a polished app rail and a redesigned phone app ✨ - 🚀 **Even better agy support.** Chats and terminals launch with the agy account you selected. - 🧭 **A consistent look across the app rail.** Artifacts, Automations, Skills, Tasks and Plugins share a page style. Turn on the app rail in **Settings → Experimental → App Rail**. - 📱 **A redesigned phone app.** Tabs move into a sidebar, pairing takes one tap, the browser gets a bottom bar, and you can search a workspace or comment on diff lines. - 🤖 **Bots are easier to follow.** Folded bots show when they need your attention, and each bot's automation list opens filtered to that bot. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots coordinate work across your computers, connect to your apps, and run tasks on a schedule or when an event occurs. ## Coming soon - MCP servers you add once for every agent on a computer - More connectors - Easier moves for bots between computers - More performance improvements - Improvements to pull request review, plugins and the sidebar --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Bots react only when a reaction is the whole answer, Slack connector offers point to Orca, folded bots get a right-click menu and an attention ring, and Google and Gmail tools get steadier.* * fix(bots): reserve wake reactions for Orca by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47299 * fix(bots): a connector offer from a Slack thread tells the bot how to reach the card by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/50694 * fix(bots): open a bot's "All N automations" filtered to that bot by @AmethystLiang in render Markdown in saved answers to item questions by @lafraia in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/51002 * fix(bots): stop Orca item mail from suggesting a reply that always fails by @hjKim1597 drafts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/50671 * fix(gmail): reuse labels created earlier in the same modify request by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/50675 ###
